2607.00464.title: MolSafeEval: A Benchmark for Uncovering Safety Risks in AI-Generated Molecules
2607.00464.paper_summary: Current molecular generation benchmarks emphasize task complexity, molecule novelty, and property alignment; they largely overlook a critical concern: the potential safety risks of AI-generated molecules. In practice, many generative models may produce molecules with toxic, reactive, or otherwise hazardous characteristics - posing hidden dangers that remain insufficiently addressed. To address this gap, we introduce MolSafeEval, a benchmark dedicated to evaluating and analyzing the safety risks of molecular generation. Unlike prior approaches that rely on narrow toxicity predictors, MolSafeEval integrates heterogeneous safety knowledge - ranging from toxicological databases to hazard rules - into a structured molecular safety knowledge graph. This graph serves as a foundation for large language model-based reasoning, enabling systematic detection and explanation of unsafe features in generated compounds. We further categorize molecular generative models into four representative task types - unconditional generation, property optimization, target protein-based design, and text-based generation - and provide standardized datasets and safety evaluation protocols for each. By systematically revealing the safety vulnerabilities of current generative approaches, MolSafeEval offers a new lens for benchmarking molecular models and provides essential guidance toward safer, more trustworthy molecular design.
2607.00464.paper_summary_zh: 目前的分子生成基準強調任務複雜性、分子新穎性和性質對齊；但它們在很大程度上忽視了一個關鍵問題：AI生成分子的潛在安全風險。實際上，許多生成模型可能會產生具有毒性、反應性或其他危險特徵的分子——這些隱藏的危險仍然未得到充分解決。為了解決這一空白，我們推出了MolSafeEval，一個專門用於評估和分析分子生成安全風險的基準。與依賴狹窄毒性預測器的先前方法不同，MolSafeEval將異質的安全知識——從毒理數據庫到危害規則——整合到一個結構化的分子安全知識圖中。這個圖作為基於大型語言模型推理的基礎，使得系統性地檢測和解釋生成化合物中的不安全特徵成為可能。我們進一步將分子生成模型分類為四種類型的代表性任務——無條件生成、性質優化、基於目標蛋白的設計和基於文本的生成——並為每種任務提供標準化的數據集和安全評估協議。通過系統性地揭示當前生成方法的安全漏洞，MolSafeEval為基準分子模型提供了一個新的視角，並為更安全、更可靠的分子設計提供了必要的指導。
